# ICrossChainConfigManaged
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/chain-bridge/src/interfaces/ICrossChainConfigManaged.sol)

**Title:**
ICrossChainConfigManaged

Interface for contracts that need to read from the CrossChainConfigManager


## Functions
### bridgeRouter

Returns the address of the bridge router contract


```solidity
function bridgeRouter() external view returns (address);
```

### crossChainRegistry

Returns the address of the cross chain registry contract


```solidity
function crossChainRegistry() external view returns (address);
```

### defaultGasLimit

Returns the gas limit for cross-chain messages


```solidity
function defaultGasLimit() external view returns (uint256);
```

### isExecutor

Returns true if the given address is an executor


```solidity
function isExecutor(address executor) external view returns (bool);
```

## Errors
### CrossChainConfigManagerZeroAddress
Thrown when the CrossChainConfigManager address is zero


```solidity
error CrossChainConfigManagerZeroAddress();
```

### OnlyAuthorizedExecutor
Thrown when the caller is not an executor


```solidity
error OnlyAuthorizedExecutor();
```

### OnlyBridgeRouter
Thrown when the caller is not the bridge router


```solidity
error OnlyBridgeRouter();
```
